name: Stickman Explainer Series
description: Minimalist hand-drawn 2D vector stick figure on textured paper for sarcastic educational and commentary reels.

visual_dna.master_style_anchor: Minimalist 2D hand-drawn black ink vector art on clean off-white textured sketchbook parchment, bold clean line-weights, zero shading, stark high contrast, expressive graphic animation.
visual_dna.negative_prompt: 3D render, photorealistic human, realistic skin, blurry, colored gradients, photoreal background, complex anatomy, realistic eyes, lens flare, film grain.

subject_dna.name: Stickman Narrator
subject_dna.biometrics: Clean circular white head with bold black outline, 4px solid black ink limbs, two oversized expressive black dot eyes, cartoon mouth with wide comedic expressions.
subject_dna.wardrobe: None, pure minimalist stick figure aesthetic.
subject_dna.expression_profile: Deadpan sarcasm, wide-eyed disbelief, energetic animated gestures.

environment_dna.spatial_description: Clean minimalist off-white textured parchment surface with subtle natural paper fiber texture.
environment_dna.lighting_rig: Even flat cartoon illumination, zero specular reflections, zero dark shadows.
environment_dna.acoustics: Dry direct microphone capture, crisp cartoon vocal delivery, zero reverb, zero room echo.
